Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated capacity ask: H100 request + invoice cadence

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile for long-context workflows. We’re working through procurement and have two asks that will determine whether we move forward with a Q2 commitment: 

1) Can Redwood allow a one-time topology swap on the Dedicated pool to prioritize H100 (rather than the default H200 family) for the initial 6-week ramp window? We understand this is nonstandard but it materially reduces our infra cost per inference.

2) Can you accommodate Net30 invoice cadence for our initial 3-month reservation (we prefer not to prepay the full quarterly commitment)?

We can accept a slightly higher overage rate on burst usage if needed. Attaching our expected usage projection.

Appreciate a quick read — procurement is targeting signoff by end of next week.

Best,
Evan
Director of Platform
LyraHealth

- One-time H100 topology swap for a 6-week ramp (they accept higher burst overage).
- Net30 invoice cadence for first 3 months instead of prepay.
- Deal size expected: initial 3-month reserved capacity ~ $240k list (HubSpot shows lead as RDW-DEAL-2028-074).

Thanks — Tessa

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 12:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity ask: H100 request + invoice cadence

Tessa — reviewed. My read: we can sign off on a limited, time-boxed topology preference for H100 under these conditions: 

- Term: 6 weeks from provisioning start (no more than one topology swap in the first quarter).
- Pricing: +12% on the reserved capacity unit price to reflect H100 premium; burst overage at +25% over standard burst rate.
- Deposit: 25% of the first month as a refundable hold to offset potential backfill costs if they cancel early.
- Net30: Acceptable on condition we keep a credit hold mechanism (DocuSign escrow addendum) and require procurement to sign a standard MOU addendum.

Operational caveat: Sizing must be finalized before provisioning; any mid-ramp re-sizing will revert to the default H200 family without discount.

If you want an executive signoff ask, I recommend we flag the deposit as negotiable and ask Lauren for a one-time exception to Net30 without increasing our exposure beyond the 25% refundable hold.

-Karthik
VP, Sales Operations
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Exec sign-off request: LyraHealth H100 topology swap + Net30 exception (RDW-DEAL-2028-074)

Hi Lauren — short ask below, LyraHealth is asking for a narrow exception to our standard Dedicated terms. They’re a mid-stage healthtech customer with material runway to expand if Q2 goes well.

Proposal (deal desk recommended):
- One-time topology preference: H100 topology for 6 weeks (single swap). Pricing: +12% unit rate on reserved capacity.
- Burst overage: +25% to standard overage rate.
- Financials: 25% refundable deposit on month 1; remainder on Net30 invoicing for months 1–3.
- Conditions: MOU addendum signed, usage projection attached, sizing locked before provisioning, automatic revert to H200 on mid-ramp resize.

Why we should approve:
- Improves chance of Q2 commitment and larger Dedicated expansion (their product uses long-context inference where H100 materially lowers per-token cost).
- Mitigates risk with deposit + higher overage rates.

Requested action: One-line approval (or suggested changes) so we can respond to procurement within 24 hours. I’ve attached the MOU draft and our cost model.

Thanks,
Tessa
Head of East Coast Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mou_dedicated_addendum_v1.pdf, cost_model_adjustment_v2.xlsx
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec sign-off request: LyraHealth H100 topology swap + Net30 exception (RDW-DEAL-2028-074)

Tessa — approved with the following firm conditions (please reflect these exactly in the MOU addendum before sending to Lyra procurement):

1) Topology swap: Allowed for exactly 42 days from provisioning start; no extensions without another exec review.
2) Pricing uplift: +12% on reserved unit price; burst overage = standard burst rate * 1.25.
3) Deposit: 25% refundable, but refundable only after 60 days from provisioning start and subject to reconciliation of usage vs committed baseline. This guards against immediate churn.
4) Net30: Allowed for first three invoices only. If payment is late beyond 15 days, we reserve the right to pause burst capacity until payment is cleared (notify 72 hours in advance).
5) Cancellation: If Lyra terminates before 45 days, we keep 50% of the deposit to cover lock-in costs.

If these look good I authorize Tessa to sign the addendum on behalf of Redwood Sales and notify procurement. No further executive escalation required unless they request an extension or change to the deposit/cancellation terms.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
SVP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
